description: This file defines a CustomAuthStateProvider class that extends AuthenticationStateProvider to manage user authentication state in a Blazor application. It handles fetching user info from a web API, caching the user data, and constructing ClaimsPrincipal objects with claims and authorization tokens.

classes.name: CustomAuthStateProvider
classes.description: A class that provides authentication state management by fetching user info from an API and caching the user data.

methods.name: GetAuthenticationStateAsync
methods.description: Overrides the base method to return the current authentication state asynchronously.

methods.name: GetUser
methods.description: Fetches the user info, using cache if valid, or retrieves new data from the API.

methods.name: FetchUser
methods.description: Makes an HTTP request to fetch user info, handles token and claims, and returns a ClaimsPrincipal.
